title: Conjecture on the tabulated maximum values M(n,r_2)
statement: For each degree $n$ and signature parameter $r_2$, let $M(n,r_2)$ denote the maximum value of the corresponding function $Q(n,r_2,\{j_1,\ldots,j_{r_2}\},\cdot)$, with the conjectured upper bounds listed in Table. **Table-value conjecture.** The values in the table are the correct values. The conjecture records the numerical optimization results for the regulator-related functions $Q$; no proof or resolution is supplied in the source.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.08512

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2019).
source_name: Francesco Battistoni, “A conjectural improvement for inequalities related to regulators of number fields”, arXiv:1912.08512 (2021).
